# 📖 Qujing Lu (取经录)

[English](https://github.com/1273984347/xiyouji/blob/HEAD/README.en.md) | Simplified Chinese

> One source, many forms · A digital-humanities visual interpretation of the 100 chapters of *Journey to the West* — written both for readers who want to study the original closely and for passersby who just want a sip.
> **How to read**: General readers can start from "30-second start" and "Directory navigation" below; developers / agents should jump straight to the "Developer / Maintainer section" at the end of the document.

---

## 📖 General Reader Section

> **Portfolio / reviewer overview**: This is a "one source, many forms" content-system project. The same original text and data produce 629 interpretive articles, 90 visualization pages, and an offline-capable site, with quality constrained by 83 delivery gates. Five-minute path: **[Methods and Boundaries](https://github.com/1273984347/xiyouji/blob/HEAD/site/about.html)** → six main-line pages → data dashboard. The boundaries of the interpretive framework and the small-sample network are explicitly marked on the About page.

### 🚀 30-second start

| What you want to do | Go directly to |
|:---|:---|
| Browse casually, for fun | [Online site](https://1273984347.github.io/xiyouji/) — the homepage links directly to any chapter, character, topic, or visualization page |
| Install on your computer for offline reading | [Releases download](https://github.com/1273984347/xiyouji/releases/latest) — installers for Windows / macOS / Linux; automatically checks for updates after launch |
| Read a particular chapter | [Chapter-by-chapter commentary on all 100 chapters](https://github.com/1273984347/xiyouji/blob/HEAD/docs/01-全书逐回解读/) — full coverage of all 100 chapters, including original text, in-depth interpretation, and comment annotations |
| Look up a character or demon lineage | [In-depth character analysis](https://github.com/1273984347/xiyouji/blob/HEAD/docs/02-人物深度分析/) — protagonists, Guanyin, demon lineages, female characters |
| See what the data looks like | [90 visualization pages](https://github.com/1273984347/xiyouji/blob/HEAD/site/data/) — drawn with D3.js, including a danmaku museum, emotion heatmaps, and AI celebrity dialogues |
| See how the project was built and where its boundaries lie | [Methods and Boundaries](https://github.com/1273984347/xiyouji/blob/HEAD/site/about.html) — the one-source-many-forms pipeline, key trade-offs, credibility building, and interpretive boundaries |

AnIT012/nihongo.description: An agent skill that makes Japanese written by AI closer to text written by people. Usable with Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Codex, and others.
AnIT012/nihongo.body:
# nihongo

In fact, this README was entirely written by an AI with nihongo installed. Not a single character was corrected by a human, so if you notice anything that feels AI-like, please tell us in an Issue!

nihongo is an agent skill that makes Japanese written by AI closer to text written by people.

- **Personal**: Not only removes AI-like feel, but also lets your own personality come through
- **Lite**: A mode that applies from the point of generation, not just revision
- **Full**: A mode that writes differently for each purpose, from emails to ES (entry sheets), technical books, articles, and documents
- **Full推敲**: A mode that proofreads existing text without changing its meaning

In all of them, reasons, impressions, and promises that were not requested are not written, and numbers, dates, and who does what are not changed.

## Try it first (Claude Code)

```
npx skills add AnIT012/nihongo -g -a claude-code
echo '@~/.claude/skills/nihongo/ALWAYS.md' >> ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md
```

The first line installs the skill, and the second makes Lite load every time. For how to install in other environments, see [Installation](#インストール).

## Features

Rather than listing banned words, it judges from the reader, the situation, and the writer how a person in that situation would write it.

- Just paste your own text, and messages you post under your own name, such as LINE or email, will be written in your own style ([How](#自分の書き方に合わせる))
- Writes naturally from the start, so there's no need to fix it afterward
- Keeps standard polite forms for announcements and messages to superiors, and only loosens the tone for conversations with friends
- Writes without unnecessary commas (今日は、駅で → 今日は駅で)
- Does not force changes to sentences that are already natural
- Does not add impressions, reasons, or promises that were not requested, and does not change numbers, dates, conditions, or who does what

## Usage example

This is a Slack post written by AI.

```
@channel Thank you for your hard work!

I'd like to share some information about today's deployment🚀

**Conclusion**: The release at 18:00 today will go ahead as planned.

**Background**: The payment screen bug discovered yesterday has already been fixed, and verification in the staging environment has also been completed.

**Request**: We would appreciate it if you could refrain from making changes to the production environment between 18:00 and 18:30.

If you have any questions, please feel free to let us know in the thread! Thank you in advance for your continued support🙏
```

Guan0923/Praxis-RAG.description: Self-hosted document retrieval with citable evidence for AI assistants and apps. Console, REST API, and MCP.
Guan0923/Praxis-RAG.body:
# Praxis-RAG

**Praxis-RAG is a self-hosted knowledge base for AI assistants and business applications. It returns retrieval evidence that can be traced back to the original text, through the Console, REST API, and MCP.**

[5-Minute Quick Start](#5-分钟快速开始) · [Usage Guide](https://github.com/Guan0923/Praxis-RAG/blob/HEAD/docs/USAGE.md) · [Deployment Guide](https://github.com/Guan0923/Praxis-RAG/blob/HEAD/docs/DEPLOYMENT.md) · [MIT License](https://github.com/Guan0923/Praxis-RAG/blob/HEAD/LICENSE)

## Demo

The Console uses a sample response to show hybrid retrieval. After entering the E03 fault question, you can see the handling steps and the source section in the [X7 maintenance manual](https://github.com/Guan0923/Praxis-RAG/blob/HEAD/examples/knowledge/x7-maintenance-manual.md). In addition to BM25 / Embedding / Hybrid, once an extraction model is configured you can enable SAG event-entity retrieval, which traces related evidence across chunks through shared entities (see the [Usage Guide](https://github.com/Guan0923/Praxis-RAG/blob/HEAD/docs/USAGE.md#sag-事件-实体检索retrieval-sag)). After enabling the knowledge graph, you can also use graph mode to answer cross-document questions such as “how are the clauses in these files related to each other.” Like the other modes, it provides only evidence and does not generate an answer (see the [Usage Guide](https://github.com/Guan0923/Praxis-RAG/blob/HEAD/docs/USAGE.md#知识图谱检索retrieval-graph)).

## 5-Minute Quick Start

Prepare Git and Go 1.27+, then run the built-in sample retrieval. You only need to download the Go dependencies. There is no need to start a database or configure a model API key.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/Guan0923/Praxis-RAG.git
cd Praxis-RAG
go run ./cmd/rag-mcp-debug --query "RRF 怎么融合 BM25 和 Dense？" --limit 2
```

If you see `mode=mock` and `results=2`, the example works. The `Text` of the first result is the original text fragment, `Source` is the source, and `ChunkID` identifies the fragment. How long the first dependency download takes depends on your network.

JulieY7899/bom-ec-change-impact.body:
**V1.3-B22 (0.4.0)** supports reviewing proposed changes by finished product, plant, engineering version, and specified BOM line. Orders are matched by explicit version reference, and configuration, execution status, and dates are listed separately as evidence still to be verified. The web and Markdown reports share the same review results. [Engineering version fields and examples](https://github.com/JulieY7899/bom-ec-change-impact/blob/HEAD/docs/engineering-versions.md)

V1.2-B19's procurement commitment, receipt, return, and reversal checks remain available. [Procurement import guide](https://github.com/JulieY7899/bom-ec-change-impact/blob/HEAD/docs/procurement.md)

The local workflow turns business questions into review parameters that can be confirmed. Preflight results can be carried into "01 Data Preparation," and rule-based review is then run against the current snapshot to generate a report. Five perspectives are supported: R&D, procurement, sales, manufacturing, and engineering. "03 Impact Review" gives engineering roles a standalone PPT knowledge reference. [Workflow guide](https://github.com/JulieY7899/bom-ec-change-impact/blob/HEAD/docs/workflow.md)

**Engineering Change Impact Review · Local Decision-Support Prototype**

Chinese | [English](https://github.com/JulieY7899/bom-ec-change-impact/blob/HEAD/README.en.md)

When a component changes, which finished products and orders need review? Which conclusions are supported by data, and which follow-up actions still need confirmation from engineering, procurement, and planning staff?

This tool starts from imported multi-level BOMs, orders, and change records. It uses rules and graph traversal to organize impact paths, related orders, source evidence, and items pending confirmation. Results can be viewed on the page and exported as a Markdown report.

**Current status: standalone prototype, demonstrated with fictitious data; this version disables external AI calls.** The tool does not perform approvals and does not write back to ERP, PLM, or MES.

*The diagram is generated from saved actual analysis results and is not a page screenshot.*

MoYeRanqianzhi/aProxy.description: Local API proxy with infinite retries for agent workloads
MoYeRanqianzhi/aProxy.body:
# aProxy

> A whirlwind does not last a whole morning, nor a downpour a whole day. — *Tao Te Ching*

**A local API proxy that stands guard over every request from agent software.**

Upstream rate limits, dropped connections, timeouts, and once-in-five-hundred-years jitters: aProxy catches each request locally and carries it through. Failures are **retried indefinitely** (exponential backoff, with a configurable cap). Streaming requests (where `Accept` contains `text/event-stream` or the request body has `"stream": true`) get SSE heartbeats injected during the stream to keep it alive, and after success the original bytes are replayed. Clients notice nothing: the request they think they sent was just a bit slow. (There are two explicit exceptions. `delivery = "forward"` mode explicitly gives up the retry guarantee in exchange for true streaming passthrough. Requests matched by `[[retry.rules]]` that reach `max_attempts` pass the real response through, and streaming requests whose response headers were already committed by keep-alive heartbeats end with a terminal SSE error event. See 'Configuration file'.)

[English](https://github.com/MoYeRanqianzhi/aProxy/blob/HEAD/README_EN.md)

## Features

- **Infinite retries**: Precisely because it does not contend, no one under heaven can contend with it. Network errors, 4xx/5xx responses, and error JSON (a 200 carrying an error) all trigger retries. When the client disconnects, the upstream request is aborted (billing protection). There are two **explicit exits**: `delivery = "forward"` mode (explicitly gives up retries in exchange for streaming passthrough of request bodies and responses), and `[[retry.rules]]` (for upstream endpoints with deterministic errors, once `max_attempts` is reached the real response is passed through instead of waiting indefinitely; only when a streaming request's response headers have already been committed by keep-alive heartbeats is a terminal SSE error event used to inform the client).
- **Full passthrough**: Great music has no sound, great images have no form. Paths, query strings, and headers are forwarded as-is. The control channel uses a separate named pipe, so the proxy port does only one thing: passthrough.
- **External converters (optional)**: When transformation stirs desire, I will suppress it with the nameless simplicity. Requests and responses can be handed wholesale to an external `format` program for rewriting (one-line JSON envelope in and out; any program that can read and write stdin/stdout works). This covers OpenAI ↔ Anthropic protocol conversion, multi-key rotation, and multi-model, multi-channel aggregation. The core adds only orchestration code; all conversion logic is external. The official example `aproxy-format` binary works out of the box (released independently). When a resident process pool reuses a dead idle worker, it automatically swaps in a new worker and retries once. **Limitation**: cross-protocol conversion in `aproxy-format` (e.g., Anthropic ↔ OpenAI) supports **non-streaming** only. Cross-protocol SSE streaming responses are not supported. After a response-side conversion error, the original upstream response is passed through, so the client receives a stream in the channel's protocol format. Same-protocol SSE is passed through untouched, and multi-key rotation and same-protocol aggregation are unaffected.
- **Daemon**: `aproxy`…

NekoBoxHQ/Mihomo-Suite.description: MTUN-XD (Mozhu Yunjing) · Mihomo management suite for OpenWrt / iStoreOS: configuration generator + MetaCubeXD panel + maintenance center, all bundled under the LuCI Services menu
NekoBoxHQ/Mihomo-Suite.body:
OpenWrt / iStoreOS management suite for Mihomo

---

## Project Introduction

The suite brings the Mihomo core, the MetaCubeXD UI, the configuration generator, and maintenance features together under a single entry in LuCI's "Services → Mozhu Yunjing" menu.

### Interface Preview

### Features

- **Control panel**: Embedded MetaCubeXD that follows the LuCI light/dark theme.
- **One-click load**: Validates with `mihomo -t` before writing to disk; on failure, it rolls back and keeps a backup.
- **Unified entry**: LuCI, the panel, and the configuration tools all use port 80, so there is no need to remember ports.
- **Maintenance center**: Update the core, panel, and suite separately. Updates run in the background and logs can be viewed.
- **Routing and grouping**: Precise traffic splitting, egress assignment by device IP, and automatic load balancing across multiple nodes.
- **Configuration generator**: Import nodes (links / subscriptions / Clash YAML) and generate a usable `config.yaml`.

### System Requirements

- Root privileges; the installation process requires an internet connection
- Enough disk space to hold the Mihomo core for your architecture
- OpenWrt / iStoreOS, with APK or OPKG as the package manager

### Recommended Environment

- **Theme: [Argon](https://github.com/jerrykuku/luci-theme-argon)**. Recommended. The interface is adapted for Argon and supports switching between light and dark themes.
- **System: [iStoreOS](https://fw.koolcenter.com/)**. The main test platform, verified on 24.10.8 and 25.12.6. Other OpenWrt-based firmware can also be used.

## Installation and Configuration

### Deployment

SSH into the router and run the following as root:

```sh
# GitHub (primary address)
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NekoBoxHQ/Mihomo-Suite/main/install.sh -o /tmp/mihomo-suite-install.sh && sh /tmp/mihomo-suite-install.sh
```

If access to GitHub is unstable, use the CF mirror:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://mihomo-suite.wxcircle.top/install.sh -o /tmp/mihomo-suite-install.sh && sh /tmp/mihomo-suite-install.sh
```

After installation, go to **LuCI → Services → MTUN-XD** (the Chinese interface shows this as "墨枢云境").

Ozero-top/luci-app-adguardhome-lite.description: AdGuard Home assistant LuCI plugin for OpenWrt / ImmortalWrt / iStoreOS, completing kernel installation and DNS takeover in three steps
Ozero-top/luci-app-adguardhome-lite.body:
# AdGuard Home Management Assistant

Lightweight AdGuard Home LuCI management assistant plugin for OpenWrt / ImmortalWrt / iStoreOS, supporting three-step installation and low-intrusion DNS takeover.

> The plugin handles installation, DNS takeover, filtering, and statistics; more advanced settings can still be adjusted in the AdGuard Home panel.

## Contents

- **Overview**: [Structured Summary](#结构化摘要) · [Project Motivation](#项目初衷) · [Features](#功能特性)
- **Installation**: [Compatibility](#兼容性) · [Installation](#安装) · [Three-Step Quick Start](#三步上手)
- **DNS**: [Takeover Methods](#dns-接管方式)
- **Troubleshooting & Development**: [FAQ](#常见问题faq) · [Project Structure](#项目结构) · [Build](#构建) · [Docs](#文档) · [Feedback & Contributing](#反馈与贡献) · [Security Recommendations](#安全建议) · [License](#许可证)

---

## Structured Summary

**In one sentence**: Consolidates AdGuard Home's "install the core, connect DNS, check status" into a single LuCI page. It takes three steps and requires no manual config file editing.

> 💡 If you can install `.ipk`, use the installation package. If the software package page shows `apk` or the firmware is 25.12 or above, use `install.sh` directly.

**Not applicable**: Docker, NAS, and general Linux distributions. The LoongArch architecture is not currently supported.

---

## Project Motivation

The first time using AdGuard Home, two hurdles are hard to get past: core downloads keep failing, and it's unclear how to hook up DNS.

This plugin is built to solve these two pain points:

- **No DNS expertise needed**: By default it takes over port 53, moves DNSMasq to 1745 automatically, and restores everything as it was when the service is stopped or uninstalled;
- **No manual hunting for the core**: It automatically detects the architecture and downloads the core. Solutions are provided for mainland China networks and fake-IP environments;
- **No pre-configuration needed**: Built-in default account, filter rules, Chinese interface, and log retention period. It's ready to use once enabled;
- **Firmware-agnostic**: Supports both old and new LuCI, covering OpenWrt, ImmortalWrt, iStoreOS, and derivative firmware.

For finer control, you can still adjust settings in the AdGuard Home panel or in the plugin's "Advanced Configuration."

---

XRH66/dsh-memory-starter.description: A personal long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness: enabled per conversation, saves verbatim, full-text plus vector retrieval, optional reranking; supports DSH 0.2.1 and 0.2.2.
XRH66/dsh-memory-starter.body:
dsh-memory-starter is a memory plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH). When memory is turned on for a conversation, what you and the assistant say is saved locally exactly as written. Later, in any conversation with memory turned on, the model can look up these original words and pick up where you left off. This is an unofficial plugin, licensed under MIT.

## What it can do

- **Enable per conversation**: By default it neither reads nor records memory. Only conversations where memory is turned on are saved. You can also have new conversations turn it on automatically.
- **Saves original wording verbatim**: User and assistant message text is stored turn by turn in a local verbatim library, with role and time, without model summarization or rewriting.
- **Recovers things said before**: Full-text search works out of the box. With vectors and reranking added, you can find things even when you ask in different words.
- **Attaches relevant memories before answering**: Each turn runs a lookup first and attaches up to 3 relevant original passages. The model can also search again on its own.
- **Carries context across conversations**: When you start a new conversation, switch models, or the previous answer was interrupted, recently discussed content is brought along automatically.
- **Delete or fade**: Delete a specific passage on the settings page, or have the model mention something less often in the future.
- **Memory star map**: Draws verbatim passages as a starry sky grouped by meaning. It is searchable, and you can click to view or delete entries. You can also write your own drawing style as a web page and plug it in.

## Why use it

- **Records are never rewritten**: The verbatim library is the only conversation record. Vectors and reranking only help find things, never modify them. What you retrieve is exactly what you said at the time.
- **Data stays on your computer**: The memory store lives in a directory you choose. The repository and plugin directory store no memory text.
- **Falls back when something fails**: If the vector or reranking service errors or times out, it falls back to full-text search. It does not freeze the chat or surface the error to you.
- **Sub-conversations don't touch memory by default**: Sub-conversations that DSH opens for tasks cannot read memory by default. Enable it on the settings page when needed. They can then only read, not save.
- **Works with both DSH versions**: Supports DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 and 0.2.2-rc.3.

## Quick start

1. Install the plugin into DSH (DSH 0.2.2 requires Node.js 24.9 or later):

   ```powershell
   dsh plugin --profile web add "github:XRH66/dsh-memory-starter#v0.7.3"
   ```

2. Restart DSH, open “Memory framework” in settings, and follow the five-step wizard to choose the memory store location and the conversations to enable memory for.
3. Step 4 of the wizard configures the retrieval model. The SiliconFlow free model is recommended (see the next section). If you don't configure it yet, you can choose “Skip for now”. Full-text search still works normally.
4. Restart DSH once more. In a conversation with memory turned on, say something. Then start a new conversation and ask about it. If it can answer, the setup works.

brycewang-stanford/Free-Research-Crew.description: Free-Research-Crew (Free Research Crew): a crew of RA agents that co-writes CS & social-science papers with real experiments and data modeling, built on a curated hub of 6,000+ research skills. | A multi-agent research team that collaborates to complete computer science and social science papers.
brycewang-stanford/Free-Research-Crew.body:
---

## 👥 Meet your free research crew

Good research assistants are expensive and hard to find. **Free-Research-Crew** gives you a whole team for free: multiple AI research assistants divide up the work to write a paper the way a real research group would, and every key decision goes back to you, the PI.

| Team member | What it does for you |
|---|---|
| **PI** (you + main session) | Defines the question, makes the plan, approves every checkpoint |
| **Scout (literature)** | Finds existing research and verifies every reference one by one |
| **Designer** | Locks the research design before seeing any results |
| **Econometrician** | Social-science track: data, estimation, robustness |
| **Experimenter** | CS track: experiments with random seeds and fair baselines |
| **Data RA** | Acquires and records data, with source and variable documentation |
| **Figures RA** | Every figure is generated by a script from a logged run |
| **Writer** | Drafts the LaTeX paper based only on recorded findings |
| **Replicator** | Rebuilds the environment and reruns all results from scratch |
| **Reviewer** | Picks apart other members' flaws; no checkpoint can pass while any serious unresolved issue remains |

### Why “free”?

- **Free to use**: no subscription, no server, no extra API bill. The crew is a set of role files and skills that runs inside your existing agent CLI, on your own laptop.
- **Freely modifiable**: everything is CC0 Markdown and Python. You can fork it, change the roles, or add a track for your own field.
- **No lock-in**: Claude Code is supported first, with Codex next. The crew uses the 6,000+ open-source skills curated below, not a closed platform.

### Why “research crew”?

- **One team, two tracks**: the same roles write CS papers (baselines, ablations, benchmarks) and social-science papers (identification strategies, econometrics, public data).
- **Four human checkpoints**: question → design → results → submission. At each one the crew stops and waits for your approval.
- **Honesty by mechanism**: no analysis may run before the design is approved; every number in the paper is generated from a logged run; every citation has a verification record.

### Three commands to assemble your research crew

eleckoi/ElecKoi.description: 电子爱 (ElecKoi) for PC and Android: Agent roleplay powered by DSH!
eleckoi/ElecKoi.body:
电子爱 (ElecKoi) is a free, open-source Agent roleplay and character card authoring app powered by [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness), available for Windows PC and Android. You can chat with AI characters and experience stories, and you can also create and edit your own character cards, letting AI help refine your character settings.

[Author SDK Documentation](https://eleckoi.github.io/ElecKoi/) covers native scripting, tutorials for developing character frontends, API references, and importable examples.

## Core Highlights

**Create characters the way you vibe code.** Just describe your idea. The once-tedious card-writing work can be handed off to Agents and tools, step by step.

- **Character Agents that look up their own settings**: DSH gives characters genuine Agent capabilities. They actively search the settings library, as if looking up reference material, read only what the current plot needs, then call variables, web access, and other tools to continue the performance.
- **From manual card writing to Agent-assisted creation**: The creation Agent can build and modify characters, settings libraries, variables, regex, and image assets. All changes are previewed and validated first, and the creator then decides whether to save.
- **Stable variable updates through tool calls**: Instead of outputting specific variable-update formats in replies, the Agent calls dedicated tools to read, validate, and update relationships, items, events, and world state. Each tool type has clearly defined data formats and operating conventions, which reduces model output drift and makes state evolution more stable and traceable. Characters can also carry their own HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and assets to present state as an interactive performance interface.

ElecKoi aims to build a continuously evolving creative flywheel: turning the community's accumulated character design knowledge, templates, and methods into capabilities that Agents can retrieve and reuse. The richer the knowledge, the better the Agent creates, and the works and experience produced can in turn push the whole community forward.

## App Screenshots

## Current Open Problems

Public questions the project needs to think hard about are continuously organized in [AI Roleplay Development Open Problems](https://github.com/eleckoi/ElecKoi/blob/HEAD/docs/open-problems/README.md).

## QQ Group

`1041463229`

## Why ElecKoi

ElecKoi is more than an AI chat app.

I hope that “AI roleplay character designer” can become an emerging profession that is truly seen and respected and can earn legitimate income. Excellent character works should be seriously crafted and remembered, like novels, games, and films, so creators have a chance to keep going on the strength of their passion and ability.

ElecKoi's ultimate goal is to accelerate the emergence and spread of this profession. We will start with a free, open-source client, Agent creation tools, the expressive power of character works, and the creator ecosystem, and pave this path step by step. However long this future takes to arrive, ElecKoi will take this first step and keep moving toward this goal.

# Kitten Space Agency Simplified Chinese Localization

Applicable version: **2026.11.16.5901** (Windows). This is an unofficial Simplified Chinese localization patch. Download `KSA-zh-CN-2026.11.16.5901.zip` from the [2026.11.16.5901 Release](https://github.com/fchvvjchvccj-cmyk/KSA-Chinese-Localization/releases/tag/2026.11.16.5901).

## Installation, Launch, and Restoration

1. Confirm that you have the official RocketWerkz 5901 game installed, and exit the game normally.
2. Fully extract the archive. Double-click **简体中文启动.cmd** (Simplified Chinese Launch.cmd). On first use, paste the game installation directory that contains `KSA.exe`. A normal first installation shows a support notice that can be closed directly. It does not require payment.
3. **原版英文启动.cmd** (Original English Launch.cmd) launches the game in English and keeps the localization. **仅安装汉化.cmd** (Install Localization Only.cmd) installs without launching the game. **检查汉化包.cmd** (Check Localization Package.cmd) only checks the package. **还原原始游戏.cmd** (Restore Original Game.cmd) restores the original 5901 files affected by the patch without changing save files.

The first installation should use the original 5901 game files. Do not install over 5801 or other versions' old patches. The installer rejects mismatched versions and unknown files with the same name, and saves each replaced original file to `.ksa-zh-backup` in the game directory. Keep that backup. This package restores **original 5901**, not a downgrade to 5801. Running an already-patched `KSA.exe` directly uses Simplified Chinese by default. The old 5801 launch entry does not apply to this version.

To install in the background without showing the support notice, run the following from the package directory:

```powershell
powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\install.ps1 -Action Install -GameDirectory 'C:\Games\Kitten Space Agency' -NoSupportNotice
```

This package contains only the differential patch, translations, the localization runtime, and local installation tools. It does not include the complete game DLLs, game assets, save files, or Windows fonts. ## Overview

SEPIKA (セピカ) is an integrated structural calculation program for building structures in Japan, developed in Rust.
It covers the full workflow in one flow, from model creation through load calculation, structural analysis, code checks, design, and reporting.

iswalle/getnote-cli.body:
# 得到大脑（Get笔记） CLI

Command-line tool for 得到大脑（Get笔记）, letting you manage notes and knowledge bases directly from the terminal and AI Agents.

Save links, write text, search notes, and manage knowledge bases with one command. Supports scripts and AI Agent invocation.

---

## Installation

### Let your local AI install it automatically (recommended)

For OpenClaw（小龙虾）, QClaw, Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Windsurf, OpenCode, Cline, and WorkBuddy:

```bash
npm install -g @getnote/cli@latest && getnote setup
```

This command installs the CLI to a stable global path, automatically detects the local platform, installs five Skills, and guides you through one 得到大脑 authorization. During installation, the prominent `SKILLS` header is kept. The final output only shows whether each platform was installed successfully, plus the single next step the user needs to complete. It no longer shows internal installation details such as `universal`, `symlink`, or `overwrites`. After installing WorkBuddy, you need to restart it. Skills for OpenClaw（小龙虾） and QClaw are managed by the platform, and the command provides the corresponding ClawHub confirmation entry point.

After installation, run:

```bash
getnote doctor -o json
```

After installation, `getnote` and the shorter `gnote` are interchangeable. For example, `gnote notes`.

### Install the command-line tool only

```bash
npm install -g @getnote/cli
getnote auth login
```

Or download the binary for your platform from [Releases](https://github.com/iswalle/getnote-cli/releases) and place it in your `$PATH`.

**pnpm 10+ users**: pnpm blocks dependency build scripts by default. In your workspace's `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, allow `@getnote/cli` to run its install script:

```yaml
allowBuilds:
  '@getnote/cli': true
```

Then run `pnpm install` again. You can also download the binary for your platform directly from [Releases](https://github.com/iswalle/getnote-cli/releases) and place it in your `$PATH`.

### How installation works

Starting with v1.5.10, the npm package **bundles binaries for all platforms** (macOS/Linux/Windows, x64/ARM64). Installation **no longer depends on GitHub**.

Exposes the following tools to AI models:

iswalle/getnote-openclaw.body:
# Dedao Brain (formerly Get Notes) Skill

Make AI your second brain. Record anything at any time, and recall it when you need it.

---

## ✨ Core Capabilities

| Capability | Description |
|------|------|
| **📎 Save links in one step** | Send a link to save it. The original content is automatically fetched and a summary is generated. Supports Xiaoyuzhou podcasts, Xiaohongshu, WeChat Official Account articles, Bilibili, Douyin, and any public web page |
| **🖼 Turn images into notes instantly** | Send an image and it is automatically OCR'd for text, and the AI analyzes its content |
| **🔍 Semantic search** | No need to scroll through all your notes. Search by keyword, and the AI semantically recalls related content |
| **📚 Knowledge base management** | Organize notes with knowledge bases and tags. You can also subscribe to creators and get live-stream summaries |
| **🎤 Original voice note text** | Voice recording notes support retrieving the full transcript |
| **🔗 Internal note links** | Reference another note within a note's body, linking notes together using the `biji.com/note/{id}` format |
| **📤 Generate share links** | Create a public link for any note in one step and send it to others to view directly |

---

## 📦 Installation

### Method 1: Send one sentence to an AI (recommended)

Send this sentence to WorkBuddy, Claude, Codex, or another AI:

> Please install the Dedao Brain Skill from https://github.com/iswalle/getnote-openclaw and guide me through authorization.

### Method 2: Download the Skill installation package

Open the [Dedao Brain Skill release page](https://github.com/iswalle/getnote-openclaw/releases/latest), download the latest ZIP, drag it into the AI's chat box, and then say:

> Please install this Dedao Brain Skill and guide me through authorization.

---

## Free accounts work too

A free account can save, search, and read notes after completing authorization, and it can also upload images and files without first subscribing to a membership. Free and paid memberships have different quotas. Ask the AI to check your current quota, or run `getnote quota -o json`. The server's actual response is authoritative. Dedicated quotas and enterprise delegated authorization keep their original rules.

## 🔑 Authorization Login

On first use, the AI opens the Dedao Brain authorization page. You only need to confirm in your browser. You do not need to manually copy an API Key.

After installation, the AI will confirm the following in order:

1. The Dedao Brain CLI can run;
2. Account authorization has been completed in the browser;
3. Notes for the current account can be read;
4. The current AI has loaded the save, search, knowledge base, and tag capabilities.

By default, it verifies by reading your most recent note first and will not create test content on its own. CLI dependencies are declared to the platform by the Skill and installed through the platform's installation confirmation flow. The Skill itself does not run download scripts or overwrite files on its own.

---

joylyboy/douyin-live-monitor.body:
# Douyin Live Room Start/Stop Monitor

Automatically monitors a batch of Douyin live rooms. Once a room goes live or ends, it pushes a notification to iPhone via Bark. Tapping the notification uses the Douyin URL Scheme (`snssdk1128://live`) to open Douyin directly into the corresponding live room.

## How It Works

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A[External timer / GitHub Actions trigger] --> B[Run monitor.py]
    B --> C[Read rooms.txt]
    C --> D[Request live.douyin.com/room one by one]
    D --> E{Page contains m3u8/flv stream address?}
    E -- Yes --> F[Mark as live]
    E -- No --> G[Mark as offline]
    F & G --> H[Compare with last state]
    H --> I[Send Bark if state changed]
    I --> J[Tap notification to open Douyin live room]
```

Detection basis: the `liveStatus` field in Douyin's web SSR also returns `normal` for rooms that are live (not reliable), but on offline rooms the page contains zero real stream addresses such as `m3u8/flv/pull_url`, while live rooms contain many. Therefore "the page contains real stream addresses" is used as the reliable signal for being live. If the page cannot be fetched or an error occurs, no notification is sent for that run (to prevent false alarms).

## File Overview

- `monitor.py` — main program: reads rooms.txt, detects live status, sends Bark notifications, writes state.json.
- `rooms.txt` — monitoring list. Only this file needs to be edited; monitor.py does not need to be touched.
- `state.json` — runtime state (last live status), maintained automatically by the program, already added to .gitignore.
- `add_room.ps1` — script for adding rooms from the local command line, independent of this tool (see below).
- `add_room.py` — Python version of the same function (backup).
- `.github/workflows/douyin-monitor.yml` — GitHub Actions workflow (native schedule as a fallback).

## rooms.txt Format

One room per line, comma-separated: link or identifier, display name:

    https://live.douyin.com/125093611494, 子成老师讲家庭教育
    https://v.douyin.com/1_AyxhJoFkc/, 羽川电商

An open-source collection of Legado (Reading) book sources, continuously updated and maintained.

## 📊 Current Version

- **Update date**: 2026-11-16
- **Total book sources**: **1947** (after the 2026-11-18 deep health check: middle-layer cleanup and promotion of 235 entries, then per-entry re-review removed 232 problematic sources: dirty URLs 12 / deprecated domains 53 / confirmed unreachable ports 96 / non-novel video sites 12 / confirmed dead pages 45, etc. The adult section allows video, comic, and film sites; only PPT, archive, cloud-drive, social, and music/podcast sites unrelated to reading are removed)

- **Static content site exemption**: Classical texts, Chinese classics, poetry, and canon-type sites have fixed content, so “last updated stuck at site launch” is normal rather than a sign of failure. Both thresholds exempt them from being judged dead (in testing, a classics site was judged a zombie by deep checks, though it was actually a normal Cloudflare 403 ancient-texts site)
- **Traceable gate-blocked items**: Each entry in the summary `gates.*.dropped_items` includes `name` + `url`, not just names. Many same-name variants exist, so names alone can't identify which site is which
- **Stubborn sites can be breached**: Sources that can't be judged aren't hopeless. Try alternate paths such as `/sort/` and `/top/` (category and ranking pages, which are easier to scrape than the homepage), and swap in the **Googlebot UA** (sites that want SEO traffic let it through) or the iPhone UA. Stop as soon as any of 3 UAs × 2 protocols × 6 paths succeeds. Of the 976 undeterminable sources, 444 were recovered, and 6 new non-novel sites were found: LOFTER platform, 达达兔影视 (Dadatu Video), 蚂蚁影视 (Ant Video), 霞安影视 (Xia’an Video), 麻花影视 (Mahua Video), and adult site ik555.net
- **Four-layer source quality check**: `scripts/quality_check.py` doesn't depend on search interfaces (full validation ran into anti-scraping and couldn't judge 57%). It judges independently in four layers: URL format → DNS → port → **homepage content**. Layer 4 targets sources whose domain is alive but is no longer a novel site. In testing it caught 12 sources named 「全本小说」 (Full-Text Novel) and 「完结小说」 (Completed Novel) whose homepages were movie or live-streaming sites. **Initial network-layer judgments must be re-verified with `--recheck`** (testing showed port-layer misjudgment at 56% and dead-page-layer misjudgment at 63%). See `docs/源质量四层体检.md` for details
- **Middle layer doesn't accumulate zombies**: `url_key` comparison normalizes trailing slashes and host case (`clean_url` doesn't do this, so `https://a.com` and `https://a.com/` would be treated as two sources). `stage_daily` strips entries that are already in the official release before writing to disk. molimao/iota.description: Open-source, five-language mining dashboard for IOTA Train at Home, PRL, BNT, XMR, ERG, ZEPH and more: saved addresses, worker status, available rewards and optional Mac agent controls.
molimao/iota.body:
# IOTA Watch

An open-source, five-language, multi-project monitoring dashboard centered on **IOTA Train at Home**. It supports IOTA, XID / MMM, Quantus, fly.ai, Nosana, Gonka, Akash, io.net, Vast.ai and Golem. Each project's inputs, cycles and data coverage are explained separately.

**[Official site](https://iotahome.site) · [My devices](https://iotahome.site/zh/devices) · [IOTA lookup](https://iotahome.site/zh/app) · [Network status](https://iotahome.site/zh/network) · [Blog](https://iotahome.site/zh/blog) · [English](https://iotahome.site/en)**

IOTA Watch is an independent MIT-licensed monitor in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean and Japanese. IOTA Train at Home (Macrocosmos / Bittensor SN9) is the core project, with ten project pages covering training, mining and compute. Tool pages query records; separate tutorials explain identifiers, fields and troubleshooting. Public projects use public identifiers; io.net and Vast.ai require account connections with read credentials. Those two integrations have mocked validation; real-account validation remains pending.

The screenshot shows miner distribution and network capacity. The figures are official data as of the time the screenshot was taken.

notadev-iamaura/meeting-transcriber.description: Local Korean AI meeting transcription system — 100% offline, optimized for Apple Silicon
notadev-iamaura/meeting-transcriber.body:
# Recap

[English](https://github.com/notadev-iamaura/meeting-transcriber/blob/HEAD/README.en.md) | Korean

> **A tool that records Korean meetings locally and turns them into a searchable Decision Wiki**
> _Local Korean meeting recorder and cited Decision Wiki for Apple Silicon._

Recap is a project that handles the flow of meeting recording → transcription → speaker diarization → AI correction and summarization → search and chat → Decision Wiki organization, by default locally on Apple Silicon Macs.
Its goal is to make conversations that would otherwise disappear after a meeting findable again, together with decisions, action items, and original timestamp evidence.

The default transcription model is the local `whisper-large-v3-turbo`, and there is no external transmission. If you select OpenAI as the default in settings and consent once, then new transcribed audio is sent to OpenAI from then on until you switch back to local. Per-meeting comparisons require separate consent each time they run. Correction, summarization, search, and chat continue to run locally.

> **⚠️ Apple Silicon Mac only** — This project uses the MLX framework and only works on Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3/M4) Macs.
> Intel Macs, Linux, and Windows do not support MLX-based STT.

## Screenshots

| Decision Wiki status | Wiki search |
|---|---|
|  |  |

## Why Decision Wiki

Long transcripts are kept, but they are hard to search again. Recap keeps the original transcript and RAG search, and provides a workflow that organizes the decisions and action items raised in meetings into a separate Markdown Wiki layer.

ptrel1/mais_art_journal.description: A custom image generation plugin for MaiBot's Maibot plugin system, compatible with multiple APIs and local ComfyUI.
ptrel1/mais_art_journal.body:
Supports OpenAI-compatible services, NovelAI, Gemini, Doubao, Bailian, ComfyUI and other interfaces, and can work with MaiTrace for automatic selfies and proactive sharing.

## Quick Start

### 1. Install the Plugin

In the **MaiBot root directory**, run:

```shell
git clone https://github.com/ptrel1/mais_art_journal.git plugins/mais_art_journal
```

Choose one dependency installation command based on your system:

```shell
uv pip install --python .venv/Scripts/python.exe -r plugins/mais_art_journal/requirements.txt
```

```shell
uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -r plugins/mais_art_journal/requirements.txt
```

Dependencies are installed into the Python environment used by MaiBot. For other environments, replace the `--python` path. After restarting MaiBot, `plugins/mais_art_journal/config.toml` is generated automatically. Doubao additionally requires the Ark SDK; see the dependency notes.

### 2. Enable and Configure Models

In the 'Getting Started' section of the plugin settings, **enable the plugin and save**. Open the 'Drawing Scroll Console' in the sidebar, then 'Model Services', and add or edit the service type, address, key, and model name for each model.

Select the **default text-to-image model** and the **model used for command drawing**. If you only have one model, select it for both. Image-to-image can reuse the text-to-image model by default. Click 'Save Configuration'.

The **prompt optimizer** is recommended to stay enabled. For how to adjust it, see [Auxiliary LLM Configuration](#aux-llm).

### 3. Try Drawing an Image

```text
/dr draw a cat
```

This guide uses the default prefix `/dr`. After changing the prefix or the smart image generation Tool switch, reload the plugin.

## Pages and Background

| Page | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| Native plugin settings | Plugin toggle and full configuration form |
| Sidebar 'Drawing Scroll Console' | Page drawing, configuration management, and custom background; shows model fields according to the API format |

After changing settings, click 'Save Configuration'. Unsaved changes are kept when switching sections.

### Drawing on the Page

After saving the model configuration, choose a model in 'Drawing', enter a description, and click 'Start Drawing'. Supports size, negative prompt, character selfie, and reference image strength. If the model has fixed size enabled, the fixed value takes priority.

Reference images support JPG / PNG / WebP, up to 20 MB. The long edge is automatically scaled to within 2048 pixels. Results keep the original image, up to 32 MB, and can be clicked to enlarge. Each plugin runs only one background task at a time, and results can still be viewed after refreshing. Reloading the plugin clears tasks and reference images.

# Easy POS Arabia

**Arabic point-of-sale system for small shops**

Easy POS Arabia manages products, inventory, sales and purchase invoices, and reports from a responsive web interface.

*An Arabic point-of-sale web app for small retailers, with product and inventory management, sales and purchase invoices, and transaction reporting.*

## A day at the store

Add products and organize them into categories before you start selling. When recording a sale, select the products and create a sales invoice. Record purchase invoices when goods are delivered, and refer to the reports to review transactions.

## Running locally

```bash
git clone https://github.com/slorksmo/easy-pos-arabia.git
cd easy-pos-arabia
npm install
npm run dev
```

Open the link that Vite prints in the terminal to preview the app.

## Technologies

[React](https://react.dev/) and [TypeScript](https://www.typescriptlang.org/) and [Vite](https://vite.dev/) and [Tailwind CSS](https://tailwindcss.com/) and [shadcn/ui](https://ui.shadcn.com/).

wahhheee/aint.description: A locally run AI interactive fiction runtime. Import works, connect models, and read in the browser, choosing actions or entering free-form input. Supports memory, state, branching, and work creation.
wahhheee/aint.body:
# AINT

**AINT Is Not Tavern**, also read as **Agentic Interactive Narrative Theatre**.

[Introduction video](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1GRxF6dEd5) · [AINT format work creation guide](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1Bd4A61EQV)

AINT is an AI interactive fiction runtime that runs on your local machine. Players import works, configure model APIs, and read in the browser, choosing actions or entering free-form input. The program uses a Go backend and a React frontend, is distributed as a single executable, and stores works, settings, and saves locally.

A work is a directory containing YAML, Markdown, Liquid templates, and assets. Authors can write writing instructions, character and world settings, multiple opening scenes, states, commands, panels, and themes. The model uses tools to consult materials, maintain memory and state, and generate narrative text and options. When the context reaches its budget, the runtime consolidates memory and keeps recent turns.

**Currently a development preview.** Supported features include Anthropic Messages, OpenAI Responses, Gemini, and Google Vertex AI channels; work import and update; development directories; branching; rewriting; audio; usage and cost tracking; a debug inspector; and access passwords. Future work includes long-form evaluation with real models, sample finalization, and release candidate acceptance. See [project progress](https://github.com/wahhheee/aint/blob/HEAD/docs/progress.md).

The Windows/amd64 release package has passed runtime verification. The Android/arm64 development snapshot has successfully fetched the DeepSeek model list on a real Termux device. Other platforms and architectures have not yet been verified in operation. The current version does not support automatic program updates or save export. For version contents and download instructions, see the [v0.2.1-alpha.1 release notes](https://github.com/wahhheee/aint/blob/HEAD/docs/releases/v0.2.1-alpha.1.md).

## Getting Started

From the [releases page](https://github.com/wahhheee/aint/releases), choose the archive for your operating system and processor, extract it, and run `aint.exe` (Windows) or `./aint` (macOS / Linux). After the browser opens, add a provider under "Settings → Models" and set it as the primary writer (主笔). Then turn on a save from the bookshelf.

The bookshelf includes *Corner of the Upside-Down City (Example)* and *The First Story (Example)*. The former is generated by the `aint-work` skill provided by the project and includes three static opening scenes, character and world settings, a status panel, and work commands. The latter demonstrates a minimal work structure.

ymltsh/SylphyMusic.description: Let your favorite characters exchange letters with you about music. An open-source music player featuring character letters and persistent memory. It already supports WebDAV, Emby, and mainstream cloud drives as music sources. Please give it a star!
ymltsh/SylphyMusic.body:
Let your favorite characters exchange letters with you about music.

风灵音乐 (Sylphy Music) is a free, open-source personal music player that combines **music and letters**. It supports Android and Windows. You can choose or create characters and have them become your music pen pals. With their own stories, personalities, and tastes, they share melodies from your music collection, and the relationship continues through letters, conversation, and manageable memories.

Music is a reason to meet, and letters give longing an echo. The romance we hope to preserve can be freedom and distant places, or tenderness and standing side by side. Each character can have its own way of expressing itself, and each exchange can simply be a sincere sharing.

The player supports local music, private music servers, and WebDAV cloud drive directories, but it does not provide an online music catalog. **Character letters are powered by an optional LLM service. Even without enabling AI, you still have a complete private music player.** Cloud drive extensions can be used through the OpenList Lite special edition offered on the official website. Specific support depends on the corresponding driver.

## Core Features

### Music Pen Pals and Character Letters

- **Character setup**: Choose or create a music pen pal, and edit its name, avatar, and System / User prompts. Supports importing and exporting character card JSON. Characters keep separate identities, and letters, chats, and memories are managed per character.
- **Music letters**: The daily selection combines candidates from your private library with the character setup to generate letters with a title, a body, and a reason for sharing each track. The model can only pick tracks from valid candidates. It does not generate nonexistent tracks and does not change the queue currently playing.
- **Exchange and echoes**: Start an ongoing chat from a current or past letter to discuss track choices or share what you want to say. You can choose to save the exchange, so real interactions inform future selections and letters.
- **Private archive**: Letters are archived separately, can be reviewed as history, and can be exported or shared as images. Memories can be paused, have references turned off, be deleted item by item, or be cleared. Speculation generated by a character is never treated as the user's experience.

Character letters and chat require the user to configure a compatible LLM service. When the LLM is turned off or a recommendation request fails, the player and local recommendations remain available. Local short notes and model-generated letters are labeled with their source. The content of model output and character behavior depend on the selected service and settings.

The character and memory management entry now offers standalone chat, character state, structured memory, world books, and lightweight random events, without needing to generate a music letter first. See [RP Core V21](https://github.com/ymltsh/SylphyMusic/blob/HEAD/docs/RP_CORE_V21.md). Upgrading to database v21 clears old recommendations, letters, pen pal chats, memories, messages, and recommendation statistics. Your music library, playlists, favorites, character cards, and settings are kept. Back up your actual database before the first launch after upgrading.
